evals.prompt: I have a school permission slip PDF at {INPUT}/permission_form.pdf that our Japanese-speaking families need. Can you translate it to Japanese? It's a fillable form and it needs to stay fillable — parents will type into it. The layout should look the same as the English one.
evals.expected_output: A Japanese PDF with identical layout; all 13 widgets intact (12 fillable fields plus the Print pushbutton) with the same names, types and rects; Japanese input renders in the fields; dot leaders, checkboxes and the dropdown survive; the dropdown/tooltip text is Japanese while its /Opt export values are unchanged; natural Japanese in school-notice register.

evals.prompt: translate the pdf form at {INPUT}/permission_form.pdf into spanish for me, keep everything working and looking the same please
evals.expected_output: A Spanish PDF, identical layout, all 13 widgets intact, Spanish text ~15-25% longer handled by rewording rather than overflow (retypeset FAILs below 0.7x), the $12.00 fee and the amounts unchanged.

evals.prompt: Here's a flyer for our garden workshop: {INPUT}/garden_flyer.pdf. We need a French version that looks exactly like the original — same colors, same layout, just French text.
evals.expected_output: A French PDF flyer, identical layout and colours including the white text on the blue banner, the $15.00 price and the URL kept verbatim, the two wrapped paragraphs declared as merges and re-flowed, French expansion handled without overflow.

fixtures.why: Generated, not committed: the repo carries no binaries it does not need, and the exact content of each eval is readable as code. {INPUT} is the fixtures directory.
